cases.name: setup: create story
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"autobug-test",title:"AutoBug",description:"test",type:"feature",priority:"high"}); $ctx.sid = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; return r

cases.name: bug_list returns bugs with required fields
cases.execute: const sid = await $testStory({phase:"TEST",checklist:[{id:"CHK-001",title:"t"}]}); const bugs = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:sid}).bugs; return bugs.every(b => typeof b.id === 'string' && typeof b.title === 'string' && typeof b.status === 'string')

cases.name: bugs have id title status foundAt
cases.execute: const {BugRecord} = {BugRecord:null}; const bugs = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}).bugs; return bugs.every(b => b.diagnose === undefined || (Array.isArray(b.diagnose.rootCause) && typeof b.diagnose.suggestedFix === "string"))

cases.name: story_get and bug_list return expected fields
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}); return typeof r.bugs === 'object' && Array.isArray(r.bugs)

cases.name: bug_report rejects duplicate bug ID
cases.execute: const bid = "BUG-dedup-"+Date.now(); $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:bid,title:"t1",fixtureId:"fid-"+Date.now()}); try { $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:bid,title:"t2",fixtureId:"fid2-"+Date.now()}); return false; } catch(e) { return e.message.includes("already exists") || e.message.includes("Bug "+bid); }

cases.name: bug_list bugs have id and title fields
cases.execute: $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:"BUG-fields-"+Date.now(),title:"field check",fixtureId:"fid-"+Date.now()}); const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}); return r.bugs.length > 0 && r.bugs.every(b => typeof b.id === 'string' && typeof b.title === 'string')

cases.name: bug_list on empty story returns no bugs
cases.execute: const sid = await $testStory(); const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:sid}); return r.bugs.length === 0

cases.name: profiler off still produces complete result
cases.execute: const bugs = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}).bugs; return bugs.every(b => b.diagnose === undefined || (b.diagnose.traceDiff === null || typeof b.diagnose.traceDiff === "object"))

cases.name: diagnose output gitDiff is string with bounded length
cases.execute: const r = JSON.parse(await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"nonexistent"})); return r.error !== undefined || (typeof r.gitDiff === 'string' && r.gitDiff.length <= 2100)
